title: Bogotá: a capital on a high plain
goal: Talk about Bogotá and comment on facts about it with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive.
grammar: el hecho de que with the subjunctive, applied to Bogotá

items: I can comment on a known fact with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive (Colombia I).
I can say where Bogotá is, what the Ciclovía is and what the city does about traffic.
I can use the new words for the high plain, the Sunday cycleway, the fair and the lane.
